provenance.scope: Swift wrapper over Apple CIRAWFilter, independent original-source persistence and existing Swift RGB development engine.
Project-generated 512x384 RGGB DNG with no embedded preview/JPEG, no camera image or private metadata; MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Native sensor initializer; local Xcode SDK CIRAWFilter.h establishes availability and settings.
EditImageInput explicitly includes RAW/DNG; shared /v2/edit resource/job path.

features: Open and Place Embedded retain exact original RAW bytes, metadata and resolved Apple decoder in a native Smart Object; default import RGB16. No embedded-preview fallback.

Edit Contents reopens the RAW source workspace. Sensor temperature/tint, exposure, boost/shadow boost, EDR and per-decoder supported lens/highlight controls precede existing RGB light/color/curve/mixer/grading/detail/effect controls.
Before/after, histogram, settings JSON, local Undo/Redo/reset, Cancel/OK and one document transaction. Shared instances redevelop together; independent copies can diverge.

Native22 legacy/chunked archives preserve source/settings. RAW remains an imported source, never a writable RAW save association. RGB8/16/32 redevelopment uses parent depth/profile and retains HDR Float32 samples.

api.adobe: Published POST /v2/edit now accepts supported RAW/DNG sensor input and applies the shared native RGB pipeline. Async status and hosted PNG output tested equal to desktop, leaving the shared document unchanged.
api.endpoint_groups: Five partial/three unimplemented; no complete endpoint claim.

menus.change: Existing Open/Place Embedded/Smart Object Edit Contents routes; no new factory menu or shortcut invented.

limits: Apple camera and decoder support varies by OS; generated DNG is functional sensor evidence, not qualification of physical camera formats.
36 million sensor/output pixels and64MiB source; existing API4MP limit remains. Standard RGB filter remains8,388,608 pixels. Large-image performance unqualified.
Highlight recovery is gated to macOS26+ and the selected decoder. Unsupported requested lens/highlight modes reject. No cloud fallback or model download.
Sensor defaults explicitly choose shadowBoost1; fixture decoder default0.9 differs. No Apple/Photoshop factory-default equivalence claim.
Cancel after File Open retains the default imported source document; Photoshop cancel-before-opening semantics remain unqualified.
Local RAW masks, further lens corrections/profiles, XMP/Adobe presets, editable PSD RAW interchange and DNG output remain open.
Exact Adobe pixel identity, live UI, physical Intel and macOS14/26 runtime remain unqualified. Offscreen NSHosting is not live evidence.
